Definition
[distance-function notation: $\partial _r,O_r,g_r,S$]

Source: petersen:page-0114 ↗ lem:pet-ch3-distance-function-submersion ↗ def:pet-ch3-second-fundamental-form

Fix a distance function $r:O o \mathbb R$. Write $\partial _r= abla r$; the level sets are $O_r=\{ x\in O\mid r(x)=r\} $ with induced metric $g_r$, and $ abla ',R'$ denote the connection and curvature of $(O_r,g_r)$. Since $| abla r|=1$, $\operatorname {Hess}r=\Pi $, and $S$ denotes the common $(1,1)$-tensor for both: $S= abla \partial _r$ measures how the induced metric on $O_r$ changes, by measuring how the unit normal to $O_r$ changes.
